policy: No unpinned downloads, invented hashes, synthetic replacement for official coverage or runtime software inference is authorized. Populate actual revision, license, ordered file hashes and preprocessing semantics before executing official-profile/model cases. This is a missing-input manifest, not asset provenance or an authenticated boot claim.

official_tokenizers.availability_scope: Pinned assets, executed official software oracle, bounded complete-table public-port tokenizer/detokenizer comparisons and a separate SPI-to-DDR boot scan; no full-shell official weighted inference
official_tokenizers.preprocessing: Raw text, no chat template, no automatic BOS; preserve the pinned ordered Split regex, ByteLevel byte mapping and AddedToken policies
official_tokenizers.unicode_semantics_status: Pinned candidate source maps use primary-UCD-audited Unicode16 classification/case folding and Unicode9 normalization. tests/qwen_integration.py now measures agreement against the actual installed tokenizers==0.21.4 oracle: 1112064 scalar NFC comparisons, 1112064 scalar-context Split comparisons, 3000 seeded ordered-Split comparisons and 93610 NFC conformance comparisons. Version2 metadata labels these source-table semantics independently. Actual installed files are hashed; embedded Rust dependency versions are not inferred from candidate crates. This is measured agreement on the recorded domain, not an exhaustive string-level proof or Python Unicode substitution
official_tokenizers.conversion_status: tests/qwen_integration.py combines all fifteen table kinds from the pinned vocabulary/merge/AddedToken, Unicode/NFC and tagged-DFA converters. All 151665 tokens, 151387 ranked merges, 256 byte mappings and 22 AddedTokens are retained without invented padding. A 66-case corpus compares independent software token vectors with the official library, then compares complete RTL token and decoded-byte vectors at seeds1/17/89. A separate complete SPI boot image contains these genuine tokenizer tables and synthetic H8/L1 zero weights; no real-model or default-geometry inference is claimed
official_tokenizers.official_reference_status: Executed project-local tokenizers==0.21.4 oracle; installed-library file hashes and complete official vectors are retained in each new preparation invocation
official_tokenizers.rtl_integration_status: Bounded public-port tokenizer/detokenizer matrix and separate real boot-loader validation passed in advisory preparation; official full-shell UART/bypass inference and reload integration remain required

official_tokenizers.availability_scope: Pinned raw assets, independent preprocessing/BPE/byte comparisons and complete-table public-port tokenizer/detokenizer RTL comparisons. SPI boot and full-shell weighted inference remain separate checks
official_tokenizers.license: Upstream LICENSE-CODE (MIT) and LICENSE-MODEL (DeepSeek Model License); both retained verbatim; no blanket SPDX grant inferred
official_tokenizers.unicode_version: 16.0.0 candidate classification data, measured against installed tokenizers==0.21.4; not inferred library linkage
official_tokenizers.preprocessing: Three ordered Isolated Split expressions followed by ByteLevel without prefix-space insertion or its own regex. Explicit raw tokenizer.json policy: add_special_tokens=False, literal AddedTokens enabled, identity normalization, no automatic BOS/EOS. A separate metadata-driven profile prepends BOS ID0 exactly once according to tokenizer_config.json and does not append EOS. The installed tokenizers backend with TemplateProcessing cross-checks independently prefixed vectors. Transformers itself and chat templates are not executed or certified
official_tokenizers.conversion_status: tests/deepseek_integration.py serializes all fifteen table kinds, retaining 128815 complete token IDs (128000 base entries, 818 AddedTokens with three shared IDs), all 127741 ranked merges and 256 byte mappings. tests/deepseek_dfa.py composes the three Isolated Split stages into 24 tagged-DFA states over 17 classes, compared independently with exhaustive symbolic and seeded span vectors. No real-model inference result
official_tokenizers.preprocessing_status: Independent primary-UCD16 category/whitespace parsing, 3345237 official individual-Split comparisons and 3015 chained ByteLevel comparisons passed; 881 independent complete BPE/byte vectors include all AddedTokens and all five exact benchmark prompts. Measured agreement is not an exhaustive string-level proof
official_tokenizers.model_bos_policy: Separate from the unchanged raw-text fixture. Metadata words5/6 enable one automatic BOS ID0, including when literal input already begins with BOS. Compare all881 original input vectors, complete token vectors and exact bytes with skip_special_tokens=False. Preserve the raw AddedToken normalized=false and identity normalization; tokenizer_config.json normalized=true is recorded rather than silently treated as an identical asset field. This is declared single-sequence policy coverage, not execution of an unavailable Transformers wrapper
official_tokenizers.rtl_integration_status: Complete table-driven public tokenizer/detokenizer vectors passed at seeds1/17/89: 880 vectors at default prompt capacity4096, plus the original 27508-byte whole-AddedToken concatenation at legal capacity32768. A compact combining-character vector also passed four-state Icarus. These are preparation results, not full-shell/boot/weighted inference acceptance

official_tokenizers.license: Public API declares llama3.2; license text not retrieved and no agreement accepted
official_tokenizers.availability_scope: Public official API resolves immutable provenance, but unauthenticated HEAD of that revision's tokenizer.json returns HTTP401 with X-Error-Code GatedRepo.
